about: More object avatars requested for the demo: soda can, desk lamp, egg carton. Same rules as demo-avatars-01: faceless (the app adds the face), no Tripo rig (the app's bend rig roots the base). No brands or text on anything.
style: Fun, charming cartoon style like a polished stylized 3D game asset: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing saturated colours.

props.subject: a soda can standing upright, glossy lime-green aluminium covered in big orange polka dots, a purple band around the top, silver top with a pull tab, an original design that looks like no real brand, NO text, NO logos, NO letters, NO waves or ribbons
props.note: Redrawn: the first version (red with a white wave) looked too much like a real cola brand.

props.subject: a cute retro desk lamp: a round heavy base, a short thick upright neck, and a rounded dome lampshade on top tilted slightly toward the camera so its smooth outer surface faces the viewer (bulb hidden), pastel teal and cream
a cardboard half-dozen egg carton standing upright on its short end like a little tower, lid flipped open at the top with three round cartoon eggs peeking out, soft beige moulded-pulp cardboard
